newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL overnight rate at 8.3/4 pct in tight market.
newsitem.headline: KL overnight rate at 8.3/4 pct in tight market.

text.p: The overnight interbank rate was at 8.30/40 percent at 0800 GMT against a closing level of 7.5/8.0 percent on Monday as the market continued to be tight, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said there was little activity and demand was mainly from small institutions considered higher risk borrowers in the market.
"The drop in the overnight yesterday was an aberration, some late lending by one bank. Today it is at the level it has been for the last few days," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
The overnight rate fell to a low 7.0 percent on Monday as a large foreign bank dumped its excess liquidity on the market.
"Despite the fall, the weighted average overnight rate for Monday's works out to 8.6 percent," one senior dealer said.
Earlier, interbank rates were mostly unchanged in Kuala Lumpur as a liquidity crunch continued to pressure the market.
They said foreign banks had some excess funds, but it was not helping to ease the tightness in the market.
"Money is in certain sectors, not in all tenures," said a dealer with a large Malaysian bank.
"The bids are in a very wide range. Bidders are mainly smaller names (small financial institutions) and offers are from mainly foreign banks," he said.
He said medium-sized commercial banks were well squared up.
One-week money was at 8.50/60 percent, two-week to one-month at 8.40/50 percent and three-month at 8.00/20 percent were all unchanged from Monday.
Interest rate futures on the Malaysia Monetary Exchange were down across the board on the expectation of a further rise in interest rates, futures dealers said.
At 0820 GMT, the three-month Kuala Lumpur Interbank Offered Rate (KLIBOR) June contract was down seven points to 91.99, or an implied yield of 8.01 percent.
The September contract was down seven at 92.33, or 7.67 percent, December was down five at 92.48, or 7.52 percent, and March 1998 was down four at 92.56, or 7.44 percent.
